dict.string: CMSN checks today's calendar for a scheduled workout (like "Leg Day") so it can auto-select your split instead of guessing.
CMSN checks today's calendar for a scheduled workout (like "Leg Day") so it can auto-select your split instead of guessing.
CMSN uses the camera only to scan food barcodes so you can log meals without typing. Nothing is photographed or stored.
CMSN Performance uses your location only while you record a run, to measure distance, pace, and the route. It stops the moment the run ends.
CMSN Performance uses location in the background only during an active run, so a locked screen or a phone call does not cut the route short. It does not track you at any other time.
CMSN Performance uses motion during an indoor run to estimate treadmill distance from your steps. It is not read when you are not running.
CMSN Performance reads heart rate and workouts from Apple Health while you run, so your heart rate can show on the run and a workout is not saved twice.
CMSN Performance saves each finished run to Apple Health — distance, time, energy, and route — so it appears with your other workouts. Nothing is written until you finish a run.
CMSN Performance connects to a heart-rate strap only during a run, and only if you turn the strap option on. It does not scan at any other time.
